scripts.build: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:admin && pnpm build:api
scripts.build:api: mkdir -p bin && cd apps/api && go build -o ../../bin/joe-api ./cmd/api
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:web && pnpm lint:admin && pnpm lint:api
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go vet ./... && go run honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@v0.7.0 ./...
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && pnpm test:admin && pnpm test:shared && pnpm test:api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @joe-kuntani/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @joe-kuntani/admin typecheck && pnpm --filter @joe-kuntani/shared typecheck
